verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a documented QuickBooks Online API ecosystem (PHP/Node SDKs, OAuth flows, and an official MCP server exposing '11 financial reports' and full CRUD across entities), suggesting GL/trial-balance-style data could be pulled programmatically, but no evidence explicitly names General Ledger or Trial Balance report endpoints or confirms open-format (CSV/JSON) export. Probes also show no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt, undercutting the 'documented in open formats' claim. Missing for 10: explicit GL/Trial Balance report API documentation, confirmed open-format export support, and a publicly reachable machine-readable API spec.
